children: Phoenix Education Partners is acquiring Fuel50, an AI-powered workforce platform. Fuel50's platform includes a Workforce Intelligence suite and Talent Marketplace, both built on an ontology of more than 5,000 skills. Phoenix Education, parent company of University of Phoenix, said the deal advances its broader strategy at the intersection of skills, work and career opportunity.
